message.content: {"output_action": "PATCH", "skill_draft": null, "patch_target_id": "t000006", "patch_section": "Core Action", "patch_content": "If the input contains multiple images from different patients or time points: (1) Do NOT apply spatial cross-verification skills (like t000001) which assume a single static state; (2) Call `chest_xray_report_generator` independently for each image to extract specific pathological features; (3) Synthesize the textual evidence from these independent reports to identify changes or distinct features (e.g., progression of interstitial thickening vs. stable nodules). CRITICAL EXCEPTION: If the images represent complementary views (e.g., PA and Lateral) of the SAME patient at the SAME time point, DO NOT use this skill. Instead, treat them as a single diagnostic unit requiring multi-view synthesis. In such cases, if the generated report indicates 'normal' findings but clinical suspicion remains high or question options imply pathology, you MUST call `chest_xray_classifier` to verify the presence of subtle abnormalities before concluding."}
